assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Six cube nets with faces coloured and labelled R, G, B, one for each distinct cube: all three colours on opposite faces; red, green or blue on opposite faces with the other two colours as adjacent pairs; and two mirror-image cubes with no colour on opposite faces.

difficulty_rationale: Needs a careful case split by which colours sit on opposite faces and an argument that the last case gives two mirror-image cubes; the Burnside count is an alternative.
